description: This file defines the interface 'EntityDefinitionUpdateManagerInterface' for managing updates to entity definitions within Drupal, including methods for retrieving, installing, updating, and uninstalling entity types and field storage definitions.

classes.name: EntityDefinitionUpdateManagerInterface
classes.description: Interface for managing entity definition updates, including methods for change detection, retrieval, installation, update, and removal of entity types and field storage definitions.

methods.name: needsUpdates
methods.description: Checks if there are any entity definition updates that need to be applied.

methods.name: getChangeSummary
methods.description: Provides a human-readable summary of detected changes.

methods.name: getChangeList
methods.description: Returns a list of changes to entity type and field storage definitions.

methods.name: getEntityType
methods.description: Retrieves an entity type definition by its ID, ready for manipulation.

methods.name: getEntityTypes
methods.description: Retrieves all entity type definitions, ready for manipulation.

methods.name: installEntityType
methods.description: Installs a new entity type definition.

methods.name: installFieldableEntityType
methods.description: Installs a new fieldable entity type with its field storage definitions.

methods.name: updateEntityType
methods.description: Applies updates to an existing entity type definition.

methods.name: updateFieldableEntityType
methods.description: Updates a fieldable entity type and its field storage definitions, optionally with a sandbox for migrations.

methods.name: getFieldStorageDefinition
methods.description: Retrieves a field storage definition for a given field and entity type.

methods.name: installFieldStorageDefinition
methods.description: Installs a new field storage definition.

methods.name: updateFieldStorageDefinition
methods.description: Updates an existing field storage definition.
